values.note: Reservations (county WebTrac portal or 616-632-7840) open 180 days ahead, need 2 nights and close a day before arrival; unreserved sites rent first-come at the camp office, so single nights are sold to walk-ups. 15-night maximum stay.

booking.source: https://www.kentcountymi.gov/1722/Wabasis-Lake-Campground ('Reservations must be made at least one day prior to arrival, sites that have not been reserved can be rented on a first come/first served basis at the camp office. Reservations require a minimum two-night stay'; 'available for reservations 180 days in advance'; 'There is a 15 night maximum stay'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kent County Parks campground in 104-acre Wabasis Lake Park, which has over a mile of shoreline on 400-acre Wabasis Lake; large sand beach and boat ramp; cabins and a lakefront cottage also rent. --Claude
summary: County page (c) 2026: $35 electric/shared water base, $40 full hookup ($24 primitive left out), no seasonal rates, $5 reservation fee; 75 sites; camp store; season last weekend of April - last weekend of October; reservable online/phone 180 days out, 2-night minimum on reservations closing a day before arrival, walk-ups FCFS (not a standing minimum); 15-night max stay; phone 616-632-7840 matches. Added reservation fee, window, max stay, season note. Amperage and rig lengths not stated (the WebTrac portal blocks automated reads). Note cleaned of price/site/season/booking/minimum text.
